Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Square Vintage-Look Sliding Mirror, 31.25"H, Natural
Colors: Glass
Materials: Iron
A simple mirror gets a clever twist, thanks to sliding barn-door hardware. Housed in a natural-look wood frame and mounted on a black iron rod, this mirror will be a conversation piece enhancing any casual, relaxed style room. Vintage look with a touch of rustic Glass, solid fir wood frame, black iron rod 31.25"W x 2.25"D x 31.25"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
